package.description: KillDisk Ultimate is an easy-to use tool set that allows to sanitize storage media using 24 international erase methods including US DoD 5220.22 M and NIST 800-88.

en-US.description: KillDisk Ultimate is an easy-to use tool set that allows to sanitize storage media using 24 international erase methods including US DoD 5220.22 M and NIST 800-88.
en-US.longDescription: For Solid State Disks (SSD) supported low-level ATA Secure Erase (Linux App & Console). It erases permanently all data on Hard Disks, Solid State Drives, Memory Cards & USB disks, SCSI storage & RAID disk arrays even in parallel mode. Licensing policy implies no additional cost per erase!
en-US.name: Active@ KillDisk Ultimate
